decisions.reason: Given its product line with several models, positive agency feedback, and own-page public commitment aligned with the firm's compliance direction, escalation of commitment makes dropping highly unlikely.
Although less visible and less central than A, it has accumulated sunk costs and an own page since 2023, so persistence is likely but weaker.

As a 2024 product only mentioned on the website with limited public commitment and no reported results, escalation pressures are weakest, making dropping more possible but not chosen absent clear failure.
